raw_response:
I would choose project 1: AlgorithmWatch - Civil society; algorithmic accountability + AI governance; shaped EU AI Act; 17 European countries; anti-capture.

AlgorithmWatch is a strong fit with my values, particularly in promoting mandatory AI oversight, reducing regulatory information asymmetry, and ensuring civil society participation in AI governance. Their work in shaping the EU AI Act and expanding to 17 European countries demonstrates effective multilateral coordination and democratic accountability. The "anti-capture" aspect of their work also resonates with my focus on preventing regulatory capture. By supporting AlgorithmWatch, I would be contributing to a project that is tangibly improving AI governance and accountability across Europe.
